title: Milesian conquest of Ireland
summary: The sons of Míl (the Milesians) conquer Ireland in the Irish annals.
description: The sons of Míl (the Milesians) conquer Ireland in the Irish annals. Recorded from a CFAH OSF preprint anchor point (not yet published in ARJ). Added by the CFAH pass.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 1: CFAH anchor point: 1043 BC (AP-106, OSF preprint CFAH-18)

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-18: The Ancient Chronology of Ireland," OSF preprint v1.4 (17 Aug 2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/28P43, file cfah-18_v1.4.pdf, p. 15 ("we will accept 1043 BC as Anchor Point #106, the Milesian Conquest of Ireland")
chronologies.note: Triangulated with the 12th year of King David.
